shared.decision: what the objective is during the bulk of the search
shared.everyone: the exact ratio R = ||f*f||_2^2/(||f*f||_1 ||f*f||_inf), with the max handled by argmax gradient or a logsumexp/beta-softmax surrogate
alternatives: optimise a p-norm surrogate ||f*f||_p for large finite p and only anneal to the max at the very end
optimise a different functional entirely (e.g. maximise the flat-band width of f*f above a threshold, or minimise the r…

shared.decision: search paradigm for escaping local optima
shared.everyone: local gradient-based descent (L-BFGS-B) plus hand-designed perturbation/homotopy moves (prune/revive, tilts, halo growth, beta ladders)
alternatives: population/evolutionary search over many candidate arrays with crossover of support structure
simulated annealing or basin-hopping with a Metropolis acceptance criterion on R

shared.everyone: fix or progressively prolongate a single 1-D grid, optimising at that resolution (coarse-to-fine halving or cumulative-mass prolongation)
alternatives: optimise on a continuously moving/adaptive mesh where knot positions are free variables (true knot-space, not just heig…
multi-resolution simultaneous optimisation: optimise coarse and fine representations jointly with a coupling penalty

shared.everyone: keep a fixed active set of positive cells during each L-BFGS call, with zeros either frozen or revived by small epsilon perturbations
alternatives: allow exact zeros to be created and destroyed continuously via a smoothed L0/L1 sparsity penalty inside the objective
represent the support explicitly as a union of intervals whose endpoints are optimised

shared.everyone: treat the array as fully general (asymmetric) and let the optimiser discover any symmetry
alternatives: impose even symmetry f(x)=f(-x) or a specific reflection structure and optimise only half the array
impose a unimodal or log-concave envelope constraint and optimise within that class

shared.decision: how the peak constraint is enforced
shared.everyone: softmax/logsumexp surrogate with a beta schedule, or exact argmax gradient, on the discrete knot values of f*f
alternatives: enforce the peak via an explicit constraint (e.g. augmented Lagrangian on max(f*f) = 1) rather than a penalty/surrogate
use a smooth maximum over a windowed average of f*f knots rather than the pointwise max

shared.everyone: a single fixed CPU-time budget split by hardcoded fractions among polish, ladder, and hop phases, with deadline checks
alternatives: adaptive budget allocation driven by observed marginal gain per phase (multi-armed bandit over move types)
restart-from-scratch many short independent runs and keep the best, rather than one long deepening run

shared.decision: what the objective is during the bulk of the search
shared.everyone: the exact ratio R = ||f*f||_2^2/(||f*f||_1 ||f*f||_inf), with the max handled by argmax gradient or a logsumexp/beta-softmax surrogate
alternatives: optimise a p-norm surrogate ||f*f||_p for large finite p and only anneal to the max at the very end
optimise a different functional entirely (e.g. maximise the flat-band width of f*f above a threshold, or minimise the r…

shared.decision: search paradigm for escaping local optima
shared.everyone: local gradient-based descent (L-BFGS-B) plus hand-designed perturbation/homotopy moves (prune/revive, tilts, halo growth, beta ladders)
alternatives: population/evolutionary search over many candidate arrays with crossover of support structure
simulated annealing or basin-hopping with a Metropolis acceptance criterion on R

shared.everyone: fix or progressively prolongate a single 1-D grid, optimising at that resolution (coarse-to-fine halving or cumulative-mass prolongation)
alternatives: optimise on a continuously moving/adaptive mesh where knot positions are free variables (true knot-space, not just heig…
multi-resolution simultaneous optimisation: optimise coarse and fine representations jointly with a coupling penalty

shared.everyone: keep a fixed active set of positive cells during each L-BFGS call, with zeros either frozen or revived by small epsilon perturbations
alternatives: allow exact zeros to be created and destroyed continuously via a smoothed L0/L1 sparsity penalty inside the objective
represent the support explicitly as a union of intervals whose endpoints are optimised

shared.everyone: treat the array as fully general (asymmetric) and let the optimiser discover any symmetry
alternatives: impose even symmetry f(x)=f(-x) or a specific reflection structure and optimise only half the array
impose a unimodal or log-concave envelope constraint and optimise within that class

shared.decision: how the peak constraint is enforced
shared.everyone: softmax/logsumexp surrogate with a beta schedule, or exact argmax gradient, on the discrete knot values of f*f
alternatives: enforce the peak via an explicit constraint (e.g. augmented Lagrangian on max(f*f) = 1) rather than a penalty/surrogate
use a smooth maximum over a windowed average of f*f knots rather than the pointwise max

shared.everyone: a single fixed CPU-time budget split by hardcoded fractions among polish, ladder, and hop phases, with deadline checks
alternatives: adaptive budget allocation driven by observed marginal gain per phase (multi-armed bandit over move types)
restart-from-scratch many short independent runs and keep the best, rather than one long deepening run

shared.decision: search paradigm for escaping local optima
shared.everyone: local gradient-based descent (L-BFGS-B) plus hand-designed perturbation/homotopy moves (prune/revive, tilts, halo growth, beta ladders)
alternatives: population/evolutionary search over many candidate arrays with crossover of support structure

shared.everyone: fix or progressively prolongate a single 1-D grid, optimising at that resolution (coarse-to-fine halving or cumulative-mass prolongation)
alternatives: optimise on a continuously moving/adaptive mesh where knot positions are free variables (true knot-space, not just heig…
multi-resolution simultaneous optimisation: optimise coarse and fine representations jointly with a coupling penalty

shared.everyone: keep a fixed active set of positive cells during each L-BFGS call, with zeros either frozen or revived by small epsilon perturbations
alternatives: allow exact zeros to be created and destroyed continuously via a smoothed L0/L1 sparsity penalty inside the objective
represent the support explicitly as a union of intervals whose endpoints are optimised

shared.everyone: treat the array as fully general (asymmetric) and let the optimiser discover any symmetry
alternatives: impose even symmetry f(x)=f(-x) or a specific reflection structure and optimise only half the array
impose a unimodal or log-concave envelope constraint and optimise within that class

shared.decision: how the peak constraint is enforced
shared.everyone: softmax/logsumexp surrogate with a beta schedule, or exact argmax gradient, on the discrete knot values of f*f

use a smooth maximum over a windowed average of f*f knots rather than the pointwise max

shared.everyone: a single fixed CPU-time budget split by hardcoded fractions among polish, ladder, and hop phases, with deadline checks
alternatives: adaptive budget allocation driven by observed marginal gain per phase (multi-armed bandit over move types)
restart-from-scratch many short independent runs and keep the best, rather than one long deepening run

shared.decision: Objective smoothing for the inf-norm constraint
shared.everyone: Use a beta-softmax / log-sum-exp surrogate over all f*f knots, annealed upward (1e3..1e10) to approximate the max
alternatives: Exact max with subgradient or bundle method (no smoothing), handling the kink directly
p-norm surrogate with p annealed (e.g., p=4..64) instead of softmax, giving different gradient geometry

shared.everyone: Fix one grid size (or a small doubling ladder) and refine at that resolution; prolongation is by cumulative-mass interpolation
alternatives: Continuously grow N throughout the run (adaptive mesh refinement concentrated near the f*f peak)
Start at very high N (e.g., 256k+) from the beginning with no coarse phase at all

shared.everyone: L-BFGS(-B) with analytic gradients and a time-based callback for early exit
alternatives: Trust-region Newton / interior-point with a Hessian-vector product via FFT
Stochastic first-order (Adam/SGD with momentum) on minibatches of knots, which tolerates the nonsmooth max

shared.everyone: Polish a contiguous window around the current argmax of f*f, with shrinking pad fractions
alternatives: Polish multiple disjoint windows around all near-max knots simultaneously
Global reparametrization that pins the peak location (e.g., shift-and-scale invariance fixing argmax at a chosen index)

shared.everyone: Deterministic single-trajectory hill-climb: one incumbent, accept only strict improvements, no population or restarts from scratch
alternatives: Maintain a diverse population/beam of candidates and recombine (crossover of knot segments)
Multi-start with random perturbations of the start construction and keep the best, spending budget on breadth

shared.everyone: Rely on the objective's shift invariance implicitly; no explicit recentering or symmetry-breaking of the f*f peak position
alternatives: Explicitly recenter the peak to a canonical index each iteration to remove drift
Deliberately break symmetry by forcing asymmetric envelopes (e.g., skew tilts) to explore non-symmetric basins

shared.everyone: Seed from a smooth analytic profile (constant, sqrt-difference, or the provided start) and let optimization create spikiness
alternatives: Seed from a random sparse spike train with prescribed zero fraction
Seed from a known-good spiky template (e.g., a comb or geometric-decay profile) scaled to N

shared.decision: How the inf-norm constraint is handled during optimization
shared.everyone: Smooth surrogate of the max (log-sum-exp / beta-softmax, tie-averaged, CVaR band, or p-norm) with a beta ladder, then a final sharp polish
alternatives: Hard max with exact subgradient / active-set switching on the argmax knot only
Explicit normalization to enforce max=1 as a hard constraint (project after each step) with no surrogate at all

shared.decision: Parameterization of the array being optimized
shared.everyone: Linear space on h (or log-space on active cells, or h=v^2), with non-negativity via clipping/bounds and a fixed active set
alternatives: Fourier/spectral parameterization of h (optimize coefficients of a smooth basis)
Piecewise-constant / spline parameterization with explicit knot positions as free variables

shared.decision: How the search escapes local optima
shared.everyone: Continuous perturbation of the current best (beta ladders, peak-window polishes, Gaussian smoothing, stochastic log-normal jitter, coarse-to-fine prolongation)…
alternatives: Population / evolutionary search maintaining many diverse candidates with crossover and selection
Simulated annealing or basin-hopping with genuinely random restarts from scratch, not seeded by the incumbent

shared.everyone: A fixed comb/staircase zero pattern inherited from the start (67%-zero comb, 2x staircase) that perturbations never re-select; zeros are frozen
alternatives: Explicit support re-selection: allow zeros to be revived and active cells to be pruned each round (L0-style)
Dense parameterization with a sparsity penalty so the support evolves continuously

shared.everyone: Optimize at the native N (with occasional commensurate lifts 2x/4x/8x or coarse-to-fine halving that always return to N)
alternatives: Non-commensurate resampling to arbitrary M and back (e.g. 3:2, irrational ratios) as a persistent search dimension
Optimize at a much larger N (e.g. 4-8x) and only downsample at the very end, never returning mid-search

shared.decision: Objective decomposition between numerator and denominator
shared.everyone: Directly maximize the ratio R = ||f*f||_2^2 / (||f*f||_1 ||f*f||_inf) via its log-gradient, with the L1 term handled by the sum normalization
alternatives: Alternating optimization: fix a target flat profile g_t and fit f to it (flatness-driven), then update g_t
Minimize a max-minus-mean flatness functional of f*f directly rather than the ratio

shared.everyone: L-BFGS-B with analytic gradients, tight ftol/gtol, and a wall-clock callback that aborts on timeout
alternatives: Trust-region Newton / interior-point with exact Hessian-vector products
Stochastic gradient / Adam with learning-rate schedules and mini-batch knot sampling

shared.everyone: Always warm-start from the provided start (or a sqrt-profile default) and never discard it unless a candidate strictly beats it
alternatives: Multi-start from several structurally distinct analytic profiles (Gaussian, triangle, random sparse) and keep the best
Deliberately start from a perturbed/degraded version of the start to explore a different basin

shared.decision: How the inf-norm constraint is handled during optimization
shared.everyone: Smooth surrogate of the max (log-sum-exp / beta-softmax, tie-averaged, CVaR band, or p-norm) with a beta ladder, then a final sharp polish
alternatives: Hard max with exact subgradient / active-set switching on the argmax knot only
Explicit normalization to enforce max=1 as a hard constraint (project after each step) with no surrogate at all

shared.decision: Parameterization of the array being optimized
shared.everyone: Linear space on h (or log-space on active cells, or h=v^2), with non-negativity via clipping/bounds and a fixed active set
alternatives: Fourier/spectral parameterization of h (optimize coefficients of a smooth basis)
Piecewise-constant / spline parameterization with explicit knot positions as free variables

shared.decision: How the search escapes local optima
shared.everyone: Continuous perturbation of the current best (beta ladders, peak-window polishes, Gaussian smoothing, stochastic log-normal jitter, coarse-to-fine prolongation)…
alternatives: Population / evolutionary search maintaining many diverse candidates with crossover and selection
Simulated annealing or basin-hopping with genuinely random restarts from scratch, not seeded by the incumbent

shared.everyone: A fixed comb/staircase zero pattern inherited from the start (67%-zero comb, 2x staircase) that perturbations never re-select; zeros are frozen
alternatives: Explicit support re-selection: allow zeros to be revived and active cells to be pruned each round (L0-style)
Dense parameterization with a sparsity penalty so the support evolves continuously

shared.everyone: Optimize at the native N (with occasional commensurate lifts 2x/4x/8x or coarse-to-fine halving that always return to N)
alternatives: Non-commensurate resampling to arbitrary M and back (e.g. 3:2, irrational ratios) as a persistent search dimension
Optimize at a much larger N (e.g. 4-8x) and only downsample at the very end, never returning mid-search

shared.decision: Objective decomposition between numerator and denominator
shared.everyone: Directly maximize the ratio R = ||f*f||_2^2 / (||f*f||_1 ||f*f||_inf) via its log-gradient, with the L1 term handled by the sum normalization
alternatives: Alternating optimization: fix a target flat profile g_t and fit f to it (flatness-driven), then update g_t
Minimize a max-minus-mean flatness functional of f*f directly rather than the ratio

shared.everyone: L-BFGS-B with analytic gradients, tight ftol/gtol, and a wall-clock callback that aborts on timeout
alternatives: Trust-region Newton / interior-point with exact Hessian-vector products
Stochastic gradient / Adam with learning-rate schedules and mini-batch knot sampling

shared.everyone: Always warm-start from the provided start (or a sqrt-profile default) and never discard it unless a candidate strictly beats it
alternatives: Multi-start from several structurally distinct analytic profiles (Gaussian, triangle, random sparse) and keep the best
Deliberately start from a perturbed/degraded version of the start to explore a different basin

shared.decision: How the inf-norm constraint is handled in the objective
shared.everyone: A smooth surrogate of the max (log-sum-exp / soft-max with a beta ladder, or a flat-top kappa penalty on the near-max band, or an exact tie-split gradient)
alternatives: Hard constraint: renormalize so max(g)=1 exactly after every step and optimize only the ratio numerator/denominator wit…
Minimize the ratio directly via a bisection/level-set on the max: for a target max value, solve the constrained subprob…

shared.decision: What quantity is optimized (the surrogate objective)
shared.everyone: The autocorrelation ratio R = ||f*f||_2^2 / (||f*f||_1 ||f*f||_inf) (or its log), evaluated on the piecewise-linear f*f
alternatives: Optimize a flatness/entropy target g_t and only later map back to R (target-shaping homotopy)
Optimize the L2/L1 ratio alone with max fixed by normalization, i.e. drop the inf term from the gradient entirely and e…

shared.everyone: Work directly on h with clipping to [0,inf) (or h=v^2 in one variant), i.e. a positivity-preserving but boundary-clipping parameterization
alternatives: Log-parameterization h=exp(u) so gradients never hit the boundary and zeros become -inf
Softplus / barrier parameterization that keeps strictly positive interior and lets support shrink smoothly

shared.decision: Whether the support (zero pattern) can change
shared.everyone: Support is effectively frozen: perturbations and gradients act on active cells only, so the ~67% exact-zero comb is never re-selected
alternatives: Allow support re-selection: L1/L0 penalty or threshold-and-revive moves that can add or remove zeros
Explicit combinatorial support search (add/drop a knot, re-optimize) as a discrete move

shared.everyone: L-BFGS-B (with one Newton-CG variant) on the full or quotient array, using analytic gradients of the piecewise-linear objective
alternatives: Trust-region / interior-point method exploiting the piecewise-quadratic structure of the numerator
Derivative-free or evolutionary global search (CMA-ES / differential evolution) on a low-dimensional quotient

shared.decision: How resolution changes are used to escape
shared.everyone: Commensurate coarsen/prolongate (stride 16,8,4,2,1) with sum-pooling and repeat-upsampling, i.e. integer-ratio multigrid on the same comb
alternatives: Non-commensurate / irrational-ratio lifts and folds (e.g. 3:2, golden-ratio resampling) to break the staircase symmetry
Continuous shape reparameterization (spline / Fourier / wavelet coefficients) instead of grid resampling

shared.everyone: A deterministic analytic seed (sqrt-profile h_i ~ sqrt(i+1)-sqrt(i)) or the provided start, rescaled to unit max
alternatives: Random multi-start with log-normal noise over many seeds and keep the best
Seed from a known-good different family (e.g. a Gaussian bump, triangle, or a previously found distinct basin)

shared.decision: How the budget is allocated across phases
shared.everyone: A fixed sequential pipeline (Newton-CG, then a Q-ladder of flat-top polishes, then a tail polish loop) with hard process-time deadlines and early exit
alternatives: Adaptive bandit/successive-halving allocation that reallocates time to whichever phase is still gaining
Population/parallel portfolio of phases run concurrently and merged by score

shared.decision: How the inf-norm constraint is handled in the objective
shared.everyone: A smooth surrogate of the max (log-sum-exp / soft-max with a beta ladder, or a flat-top kappa penalty on the near-max band, or an exact tie-split gradient)
alternatives: Hard constraint: renormalize so max(g)=1 exactly after every step and optimize only the ratio numerator/denominator wit…
Minimize the ratio directly via a bisection/level-set on the max: for a target max value, solve the constrained subprob…

shared.decision: What quantity is optimized (the surrogate objective)
shared.everyone: The autocorrelation ratio R = ||f*f||_2^2 / (||f*f||_1 ||f*f||_inf) (or its log), evaluated on the piecewise-linear f*f
alternatives: Optimize a flatness/entropy target g_t and only later map back to R (target-shaping homotopy)
Optimize the L2/L1 ratio alone with max fixed by normalization, i.e. drop the inf term from the gradient entirely and e…

shared.everyone: Work directly on h with clipping to [0,inf) (or h=v^2 in one variant), i.e. a positivity-preserving but boundary-clipping parameterization
alternatives: Log-parameterization h=exp(u) so gradients never hit the boundary and zeros become -inf
Softplus / barrier parameterization that keeps strictly positive interior and lets support shrink smoothly

shared.decision: Whether the support (zero pattern) can change
shared.everyone: Support is effectively frozen: perturbations and gradients act on active cells only, so the ~67% exact-zero comb is never re-selected
alternatives: Allow support re-selection: L1/L0 penalty or threshold-and-revive moves that can add or remove zeros
Explicit combinatorial support search (add/drop a knot, re-optimize) as a discrete move

shared.everyone: L-BFGS-B (with one Newton-CG variant) on the full or quotient array, using analytic gradients of the piecewise-linear objective
alternatives: Trust-region / interior-point method exploiting the piecewise-quadratic structure of the numerator
Derivative-free or evolutionary global search (CMA-ES / differential evolution) on a low-dimensional quotient

shared.decision: How resolution changes are used to escape
shared.everyone: Commensurate coarsen/prolongate (stride 16,8,4,2,1) with sum-pooling and repeat-upsampling, i.e. integer-ratio multigrid on the same comb
alternatives: Non-commensurate / irrational-ratio lifts and folds (e.g. 3:2, golden-ratio resampling) to break the staircase symmetry
Continuous shape reparameterization (spline / Fourier / wavelet coefficients) instead of grid resampling

shared.everyone: A deterministic analytic seed (sqrt-profile h_i ~ sqrt(i+1)-sqrt(i)) or the provided start, rescaled to unit max
alternatives: Random multi-start with log-normal noise over many seeds and keep the best
Seed from a known-good different family (e.g. a Gaussian bump, triangle, or a previously found distinct basin)

shared.decision: How the budget is allocated across phases
shared.everyone: A fixed sequential pipeline (Newton-CG, then a Q-ladder of flat-top polishes, then a tail polish loop) with hard process-time deadlines and early exit
alternatives: Adaptive bandit/successive-halving allocation that reallocates time to whichever phase is still gaining
Population/parallel portfolio of phases run concurrently and merged by score

shared.decision: What quantity is optimized (the surrogate objective)
shared.everyone: The autocorrelation ratio R = ||f*f||_2^2 / (||f*f||_1 ||f*f||_inf) (or its log), evaluated on the piecewise-linear f*f
alternatives: Optimize a flatness/entropy target g_t and only later map back to R (target-shaping homotopy)

shared.everyone: Work directly on h with clipping to [0,inf) (or h=v^2 in one variant), i.e. a positivity-preserving but boundary-clipping parameterization
alternatives: Log-parameterization h=exp(u) so gradients never hit the boundary and zeros become -inf
Softplus / barrier parameterization that keeps strictly positive interior and lets support shrink smoothly

shared.decision: Whether the support (zero pattern) can change
shared.everyone: Support is effectively frozen: perturbations and gradients act on active cells only, so the ~67% exact-zero comb is never re-selected
alternatives: Allow support re-selection: L1/L0 penalty or threshold-and-revive moves that can add or remove zeros
Explicit combinatorial support search (add/drop a knot, re-optimize) as a discrete move

shared.everyone: L-BFGS-B (with one Newton-CG variant) on the full or quotient array, using analytic gradients of the piecewise-linear objective
alternatives: Trust-region / interior-point method exploiting the piecewise-quadratic structure of the numerator
Derivative-free or evolutionary global search (CMA-ES / differential evolution) on a low-dimensional quotient

shared.decision: How resolution changes are used to escape
shared.everyone: Commensurate coarsen/prolongate (stride 16,8,4,2,1) with sum-pooling and repeat-upsampling, i.e. integer-ratio multigrid on the same comb
alternatives: Non-commensurate / irrational-ratio lifts and folds (e.g. 3:2, golden-ratio resampling) to break the staircase symmetry
Continuous shape reparameterization (spline / Fourier / wavelet coefficients) instead of grid resampling

shared.everyone: A deterministic analytic seed (sqrt-profile h_i ~ sqrt(i+1)-sqrt(i)) or the provided start, rescaled to unit max
alternatives: Random multi-start with log-normal noise over many seeds and keep the best
Seed from a known-good different family (e.g. a Gaussian bump, triangle, or a previously found distinct basin)

shared.decision: How the budget is allocated across phases
shared.everyone: A fixed sequential pipeline (Newton-CG, then a Q-ladder of flat-top polishes, then a tail polish loop) with hard process-time deadlines and early exit
alternatives: Adaptive bandit/successive-halving allocation that reallocates time to whichever phase is still gaining
Population/parallel portfolio of phases run concurrently and merged by score

shared.decision: Whether the support (zero pattern) can change
shared.everyone: Support is effectively frozen: perturbations and gradients act on active cells only, so the ~67% exact-zero comb is never re-selected

shared.everyone: A deterministic analytic seed (sqrt-profile h_i ~ sqrt(i+1)-sqrt(i)) or the provided start, rescaled to unit max
alternatives: Random multi-start with log-normal noise over many seeds and keep the best

shared.everyone: A smooth surrogate: tie-averaged exact max, log-sum-exp soft-max with a beta ladder, or a kappa-penalty tying the near-max band to the peak
alternatives: Hard exact max via a subgradient-free reformulation that optimizes only the ratio with the max fixed as a linear constr…
Optimize the flatness of g=f*f directly against a target flat profile (minimize variance of g over its support) instead…

shared.decision: The representation of the function f (support and parameterization)
shared.everyone: A fixed-length nonnegative array on a uniform grid, optimized in log-height on active cells, with the zero pattern frozen (no support re-selection)
alternatives: A sparse adaptive mesh: allow cell boundaries to move (free-knot / moving-mesh) so support is re-selected continuously
A parametric basis (e.g. splines, wavelets, or a small number of Gaussian bumps) with far fewer degrees of freedom than…

shared.everyone: L-BFGS-B with analytic gradients on log-parameterized heights, ftol/gtol pushed to ~1e-20/1e-16
alternatives: A second-order method (Gauss-Newton / trust-region on the autocorrelation) exploiting the convolution structure
A derivative-free or stochastic optimizer (CMA-ES, simulated annealing) on a low-dimensional parameterization

shared.decision: How resolution/structure is changed to escape local optima
shared.everyone: Commensurate or small-rational lifts (2x, 3:2, 5:3, 7:4) via mass-preserving interpolation, fold back, accept if fold improves
alternatives: Non-commensurate irrational or large-prime lifts (e.g. golden-ratio, sqrt(2)) that never fold back to a commensurate gr…
Continuous mesh refinement / coarsening (multigrid V-cycles) rather than discrete integer-ratio lifts

shared.decision: The escape mechanism from local optima
shared.everyone: Deterministic multi-start / beta-homotopy / shrinking-then-prolonging / lift-and-fold, with no stochastic perturbation of the shape
alternatives: Stochastic basin-hopping with random log-normal perturbations of active cells at a tuned amplitude
Population/evolutionary search over many candidate shapes with crossover and selection

shared.decision: The objective being optimized (the ratio R)
shared.everyone: Directly maximize the ratio ||f*f||_2^2 / (||f*f||_1 ||f*f||_inf) via its exact gradient, with the L1 and L2 terms in closed form
alternatives: Optimize a surrogate that targets a flat f*f profile (minimize max/mean of g) and only check the ratio at the end
Optimize the ratio via a min-max / Dinkelbach fractional-programming reformulation with an auxiliary scalar

shared.decision: The time budget allocation across phases
shared.everyone: A single sequential pipeline (base polish, lift loop, final polish) with per-phase time caps and a hard process-time deadline at ~93% of budget
alternatives: Parallel multi-start: run several independent pipelines concurrently and keep the best
Anytime/restart schedule that repeatedly reallocates budget based on observed improvement rate

shared.decision: The initialization when no start is given
shared.everyone: A deterministic analytic shape (the sqrt-difference ramp h_i ~ sqrt(i+1)-sqrt(i)) rescaled to unit max
alternatives: A random sparse nonnegative initialization (e.g. a few random bumps) drawn per run
A known-good seed from a different problem (e.g. a Golomb-ruler-like or Legendre-polynomial-derived comb)

shared.everyone: Local gradient descent (L-BFGS-B) plus deterministic resolution/scale changes (coarse-to-fine quotient cascade, interlaced upsample, beta/smoothing ladders)

shared.decision: How the zero support is chosen

alternatives: L1 / sparsity-promoting penalty that lets zeros emerge and re-grow during optimisation

shared.decision: Discretisation of the array length N

alternatives: Free N: optimise over continuous length and resample to many candidate N, keeping the best

alternatives: Portfolio of diverse restarts from different initialisations, pick best

shared.decision: How resolution changes are used to escape local optima
shared.everyone: Commensurate coarse-to-fine: coarsen by integer strides (2/4/8/16) or upsample by integer factors with linear interpolation, polish, and prolongate back

shared.decision: representation of the array being optimized
shared.everyone: nonnegative array h with positivity enforced by clipping and/or log-parametrization of active cells, rescaled so the convolution peak is 1
alternatives: signed array with a separate positive-part or square-to-nonnegative map, allowing oscillatory structure
Fourier-domain representation of h (band-limited / sparse spectrum) optimized directly in frequency space

shared.decision: objective handling of the inf-norm (max of f*f)
shared.everyone: exact max with tie-averaged subgradient, or a log-sum-exp soft-max surrogate with a beta ladder
alternatives: explicit constrained formulation: minimize numerator subject to max knot <= 1 via projected/penalty methods with hard p…
smooth p-norm (p=8..32) surrogate of the max, annealed in p, with analytic gradient

shared.everyone: frozen support: only active (nonzero) cells are perturbed; the ~67% exact-zero comb is never re-selected
alternatives: explicit support search: add/remove cells via coordinate descent or L0/L1 penalty with thresholding
continuous relaxation with a sparsity penalty (e.g. entropy or L1 on h) so zeros emerge dynamically

shared.everyone: resolution change (coarsen/prolongate, interlaced upsample) plus beta-sharpening ladders and peak-window polishing
alternatives: stochastic simulated-annealing / basin-hopping with temperature on the array itself
multi-start from structurally different seeds (e.g. random sparse combs, analytic profiles) and keep the best

shared.everyone: L-BFGS-B on a smooth (log-parametrized) objective with analytic gradients and a time-based callback
alternatives: trust-region Newton / interior-point with exact Hessian-vector products
derivative-free or evolutionary search (CMA-ES) on the active-cell vector

shared.everyone: start at a fixed N (8192 or the given start's N) and only grow via integer-factor upsampling (2x,3x,4x) with linear interpolation
alternatives: adaptive non-uniform mesh refinement concentrated near the convolution peak
optimize at very large fixed N from the start with FFT convolutions and no upsampling

shared.everyone: rescale h by 1/sqrt(max(f*f)) after each step to pin the inf-norm to 1
alternatives: fix the L1 norm (sum h = 1) and let the inf-norm float, optimizing the ratio directly
no rescaling; add a penalty term for the inf-norm constraint and let the optimizer find the scale

shared.everyone: fixed sequential phases (polish, soft-surrogate, refine, polish) with hard process-time deadlines and early exit on no improvement
alternatives: bandit/UCB allocation that dynamically reweights phases based on recent gain rates
population-based parallel search across many short restarts, selecting by score
